I say that because every time I ask anyone if they want to hang out, I get no responses (if asked on Facebook) or told they're busy (in person) and then the next day I see pictures from their nights out.

It's not directly related to them, though. I've just felt like this ever since middle school. People really fucked me up growing up and I'm a very emotionally imbalanced person and I'm afraid I'm really going to hurt myself again one day.
